summary: The DNR states that all major points raised by the Air Pollution Control Section and transmitted by Mr. Besadny have received a satisfactory response in the Air Quality Report and DOT memoranda, with the possible exception of questions related to airport development, which are expected to be addressed in the airport master plan revisions.
text: We believe that all of the major points raised by the Department's Air Pollution Control Section and transmitted by Mr. Besadny with the above—mentioned letter have received a satisfactory response in the Air Quality Report for the Airport Spur and in DOT memorandums to file of January 25, 1974 and June 28, 1974 with the possible exception of questions related to airport development. We hope that these matters will also be dealt with in the airport master plan revisions.
